verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows Godot itself offering a natural-language command interface. What it documents are a conventional CLI, headless mode, editor scripting via EditorScript and EditorInterface, and a built-in GDScript language server, which are developer building blocks rather than natural-language operation. The probes found no official MCP server, and the existing natural-language/agent bridges are third-party community GitHub projects, which earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
